hut.subtitle: A hut in the woods
hut.intro: Smoke curls from a hut half swallowed by the trees. Inside, by a small fire, sits a very old man.
hut.story: "I was a planeswalker once, from a world far from this one," he says. "There I sat before a glowing window and played at Shandalar, a game of wizards and cards. One night the game played me instead. It drew me through, and here I have stayed ever since."
hut.peace: "I am done with duels and wizards' wars. I want only peace now, and a warm fire."
hut.offer: "But I still know things nobody else in Shandalar knows. For 1000 gold I will tell you where a dungeon lies that no wise man has ever heard of."
hut.told: He counts the gold, then draws a map in the ashes of the hearth. "{dungeon}. I found it long ago, in my old world, when this was only a game. Mind its guardians. The cards I left there are yours, if you can take them."
hut.marked: The way to {dungeon} is marked on your map.
hut.waiting: The old man looks up from the fire. "You know the way to {dungeon}. Go, before its guardians grow bolder."
hut.cleared: "So you have found them all," the old man smiles. "Every place I ever hid a thing. Keep my old treasures well. I have nothing left to sell, only peace, and that I keep for myself."
hut.clue: The old man in the woods told you where {dungeon} lies.
hut.log: Paid the old man in the woods 1000 gold for the way to {dungeon}.
hut.back: The old man looks up from the fire and almost smiles. "You came back from {dungeon} alive, then. Few would. Sit."
hut.more2: "There was a library once, on a shore the sea has since taken. I read there for a whole season, when all of this was only a game to me."
hut.more3: "There was a forge the artificers left burning. The water came for that too, in the end, but not for what they made."
hut.more4: "There is a hall where every word comes back to you twice. I left it quickly. Not everything I owned left with me."
hut.more5: "One place is left, and I kept it for last. It is where I meant to stop walking, before I found this fire instead. It lies far from here."
hut.offer_again: "For 1000 gold I will tell you where it lies."
hut.told_again: He counts the gold and draws again in the ashes. "{dungeon}. It may be a long road: my secrets lie all over this land. Mind its guardians. What I left there is yours, if you can take it."
hut.dozing: The old man dozes by his fire and does not stir. Better to let him sleep.
